title: Test that an acceptance evaluation judges a workspace only on a named source root
outcome: A test covers acceptance_evaluation_judged_source and its use on both request paths (independent and same-session): a Named place yields the measured workspace, a Workdir place yields none, and both paths set task.judged_workspace. Today the workspace tests set it directly, so an inversion that marks records on a workdir, hiding records Engram admits, would pass. Review-pair Low from Claude /review-code delegation-d4287a70 on w-f8f8e04dffbb (freeze 1a4bbe3b), src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs.
acceptance: Test that an acceptance evaluation judges a workspace only on a named source root is done
